notes.title: Now available for Mac and Linux
notes.notes:
It was our intention from the beginning to make Quip Anomaly available to all 3 major desktop platforms. It just took a little extra time to get the work done. The wait is now over, so please enjoy Quip Anomaly on your Mac or Linux computer as well.

Thank you for your support.
